options.content: Frame-level drilldown. Narrow the time range and variables to inspect one incident.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts, e.topic, e.event_type, e.payload FROM mm_events e WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, payload FROM mm_events WHERE event_type = 'StrategyDecision'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, payload FROM mm_events WHERE topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:target_books:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(actor_id, ''), substring(topic from '^strategy:target_books:(.+)$')) = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, exchange, symbol, actor_id, payload
FROM mm_events
WHERE topic LIKE 'execution:%'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 100

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

list.definition:
SELECT run_id
FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id <> ''
    AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY run_id
  ) sources
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(run_id AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY run_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
